metadata.name: arrow-down-left
metadata.description: A down and left-facing navigation arrow with a straight shaft and an open V head.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Round 5 completes the eight compass arrows. Rotate the approved Arrow Right straight shaft and V head by 135 degrees about 12,12, uniformly fit centerlines to a 9.15-unit primary half extent, then bake coordinates into source. Reference centerline points before rotation are shaft (4,12) to (20,12) and head (14,6) to (20,12) to (14,18). Centerline fit factor 1.6175067620; keep Regular1.70 unchanged instead of scaling stroke. Both horizontal and vertical visible margins are exactly2px. Outline keeps an open straight-arm V with .85 round caps and joins. Filled uses the exact .85 capsule around the same shaft and a solid triangle expanded by .85 round exterior corners around those same head vertices. Tips, shoulders and exterior align at Regular1.70; the solid head is the accepted semantic interior exception. No enclosing box, broad curved-head fillet or preview transform. Existing approved Left/Right artwork is preserved. Both new styles await owner review. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. This explicitly supersedes the earlier diagonal2px-on-all-sides fit and older Left/Right size. Filled uses the same shaft with .875 caps and the same solid expanded triangle. metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Owner requested the accepted X=105%, Y=95% proportions to become native source geometry, with Lab X/Y reset to100%/100%. The original Outline centerlines are baked about12,12: x maps to12+1.05*(x-12), y maps to12+.95*(y-12). Regular1.70 stroke and round .85 caps stay fixed. Base centerline corners become ellipses rx3.4125/ry3.0875; fitted handle corners become rx1.05/ry.95. Straight sides remain vertical. Filled is reconstructed from the baked Outline with an exact .85 normal offset, represented by tangent-continuous cubic segments at ellipse corners; no runtime transform or extra box is used. This keeps the styles aligned at native Regular1.70 rather than scaling the stroke weight. Native visible bounds in both styles are x=2.75..21.25 and y=2.4575..21.5425, width18.5/height19.085. The original 2px top/bottom native-margin reference is superseded by the owner-approved baked proportion adjustment. Slots share x9.9/14.1, y10.1..16.75 with .85 round caps. Owner-approved proportions; native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved the original Trash at X105%/Y95%, then explicitly requested baking those proportions into native source and returning Lab controls to100%/100%. Preserve Regular1.70 and the fitted handle/base contours. Both styles remain approved.

metadata.name: upload
metadata.description: An upward arrow rising above an open sending tray.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: The arrow is centered at x=12 above a straight-sided U tray. The tray has a horizontal base and open top, preserving the recognizable receiving/sending object instead of a surrounding frame. Total centerline bounds x=4..20/y=3.5..20.5 balance visible padding 3.15 horizontally and 2.65 vertically. The 1.70 stroke supplies consistent rounded tray joints and free ends. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft geometry is retained; the tray follows the standard roundness below. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. The owner subsequently approved both transfer styles on2026-10-27. Owner requested the Camera/Folder standard roundness for both transfer trays on2026-10-27. The tray now uses tangent radius3.25 centerline base corners, with vertical sides x4/20, corner centers7.25/16.75 at y17.25, and bottom y20.5. Both open ends remain at y16. Filled is the exact Regular1.70 stroke band: outer radius4.10, inner radius2.40 and free caps .85. Tray visible bounds x3.15..20.85/y15.15..21.35 and complete icon bounds x3.15..20.85/y2.65..21.35 are retained. The open Outline V and solid Filled arrowhead remain unchanged. Both styles were owner-approved on2026-10-27. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner explicitly approved Download and Upload Outline/Filled on2026-10-27 with the current standard radius3.25 centerline tray corners, aligned Filled exterior and accepted arrowheads. Native X/Y100%, Regular1.70, rotation0; source geometry is unchanged by this approval.

metadata.name: x
metadata.description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
metadata.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
metadata.construction: Owner clarified that the Filled box must keep 2px outside clearance and Outline is exactly the X inside that Filled box, following Plus. The upright rounded box spans 2..22 on the native 24 by 24 grid, with radius-4 corners. Its negative-space X and the standalone Outline share diagonal centerline endpoints 4.85..19.15 on each axis, giving visible glyph bounds 4..20. The shared glyph retains Regular-equivalent width 1.70 and .85 round caps. This leaves exactly 2 units between the glyph and each box side, plus 2 units between the box and each artboard side. The cutout is the exact analytical union of the Outline stroke exterior. Both glyphs are centered at 12,12 with identical position, size and contours; no style-specific scaling or translation. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Owner-approved source. The owner subsequently requested rounder Filled box corners: radius is 4, with box bounds, glyph contour, stroke weight and the measured 2-unit side clearances retained. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9965034965 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled with radius-4 box corners, 2px around the Filled box, 2px between the box and shared glyph, and identical Outline/cutout position and weight. Reviewed at native proportions and Regular 1.70.
